title: fix(app-shell): bind the host discussion fallback to the feed pipeline
body:
Fixes #8983

One pipeline, not two. The host discussion fallback now mounts the same
renderer the authored / synthesized `record:discussion` / `record:chatter`
block does, instead of reaching past it to `RecordChatterPanel` with raw rows.

Drafted by an agent seat in Claude Code session `session_01MPaVWWMuWeT5LgB1qoXjVB`
(the id is written here as prose because a footer link does not survive an edit
to this body).

## Why the fallback exists — measured, not assumed

The triage ruling required establishing this before binding anything, since a
host context where the pipeline genuinely cannot run would call for saying so
visibly rather than binding.

It can run. Measured against `origin/main` at `e8b7b0785`:

- The gate is `showAutoDiscussion = !disableDiscussion && !hasDiscussion && feedsEnabled`
  in `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`. So the fallback fires
  for exactly one population: an **authored** page that omits a discussion
  block. A synthesized default page always emits `record:discussion`
  (`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, the `hideDiscussion` branch), so it never
  reaches the fallback. The tree says the same in as many words two lines above
  the gate: "the legacy bottom-of-page append below stays only as the fallback
  for authored pages that don't slot the panel themselves."
- It is **not** a different host context. The fallback JSX sits inside the very
  `DiscussionContextProvider` this same view opens (provider opens at the
  `items={feedItems}` mount, closes 172 lines later; the fallback is between
  them), itself inside `RecordContextProvider`. `RecordChatterRenderer` needs
  exactly those two contexts and nothing else.
- The six values the fallback passed by hand — items, loading, and the three
  mutation handlers, plus mention suggestions — are the same six the provider
  above it is already given, from the same closure variables.

So the honest answer is the binding one, and the "say so visibly" branch of the
ruling does not apply.

## Dependency measurement

Binding adds **no** package dependency edge:

- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is already declared by `@object-ui/app-shell` in
  both `peerDependencies` (`workspace:^`) and `devDependencies` (`workspace:*`).
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` already imports from that specifier — the edit swaps
  one named import (`RecordChatterPanel`) for another (`RecordChatterRenderer`)
  in the **same existing import statement**. No new specifier, no new edge.
- `RecordChatterRenderer` is exported from the package barrel
  (`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`), not a deep path.

## How it binds

`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, the `showAutoDiscussion`
branch, is now a single `RecordChatterRenderer` with `className="mt-6"` and **no
schema**. That is the component `ComponentRegistry` resolves both
`record:discussion` and `record:chatter` to, so it is literally the same
pipeline rather than a second copy kept in agreement by hand.

- With no schema, the renderer's own defaults are the three affordances this
  branch used to hard-code (`position: 'bottom'`, `collapsible: false`,
  reactions / threading / comment input) plus the protocol's `feed` defaults.
- The renderer takes no `items` prop; it reads the feed off the
  `DiscussionContext` already in scope. DOM is unchanged: the renderer emits its
  own `div` carrying `className`, so the old wrapper `div` is not lost.
- Routing a synthesized node through `SchemaRenderer` was the alternative
  considered and not taken: it would add `hidden` / `disabled` expression
  evaluation over a node nobody authored, to arrive at the component mounted
  here anyway.

Two comments that this change makes false were rewritten in the same edit — the
`record-chatter.tsx` note that recorded the divergence as live, and the
`EMPTY_FEED` note in `RecordDetailView.tsx` that named `RecordChatterPanel` as a
direct prop consumer.

## The equivalence assertions, and the controls that make them readings

New pin: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.discussionFallbackPipeline-8983.test.tsx`.
It drives the real `RecordDetailView` twice on the same feed — once with an
authored page that omits the block (fallback), once with no authored page at all
(synthesized default, so the block) — and asserts the rendered row lists are
equal **and** equal to a stated value.

"The two agree" is satisfiable by a harness in which they could never have
disagreed, so three legs hold it up:

| leg | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| PRE-FIX CONTROL | `PreFixFallbackShape` is the fallback's JSX as written before this card — same panel, same hard-coded affordances, raw `items`, no `hasMore` / `onLoadMore`. Rendered on the **same** feed, derived from the same source rows through the exported `activityRowToFeedItem`, and asserted to produce a **different** row set. |
| AGREEMENT FIXTURE | the shared row set is asserted by value, and the value is the **pipeline's** answer (completed row hidden; newest twenty of twenty-five) rather than the raw feed. Both surfaces rendering nothing, or everything, is red. |
| NEUTRAL FIXTURE | the card's own control row — three comments, no completed activity, under the page window — on which all three shapes agree. Without it the two cases above could be reporting a harness that can only produce disagreement. |

The three fixtures are the card's own probe table, re-run through the real view:

| feed | host fallback | authored / synthesized block | PRE-FIX shape (control) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 comments + 1 completed activity | 3 rows, Load more x0 | 3 rows, Load more x0 | 4 rows incl. the completed one, Load more x0 |
| 25 comments | 20 rows (06..25), Load more x1 | 20 rows (06..25), Load more x1 | 25 rows, Load more x0 |
| CONTROL — 3 comments, no completed activity | 3 rows | 3 rows | 3 rows |

A fourth case clicks "Load more" on the fallback and asserts the window grows to
all 25 rows and the button retires — `hasMore` without `onLoadMore` renders a
button that does nothing, which satisfies any assertion that only counts it.

## Ablation

Two arms, both run from the committed tree so the restore leg has something to
restore to, and both proving the edit reached disk before any result was read.

**MUTATION arm** — the fallback branch and its import reverted to the pre-fix
raw shape (`RecordChatterPanel` with `items={feedItems}`). On-disk proof taken
before the run, anchored on the exact text each way: `RecordChatterRenderer`
mount sites went 1 to 0, `RecordChatterPanel` mount sites 0 to 1, and the file's
blob hash moved from `f4fb0b7` to `6e18560` (a hash comparison, because an
editing tool exits 0 on zero matches). Result: **3 of 4 failed**, and they
failed for the stated reason rather than by crashing —

```
AssertionError: expected [ 'Comment 01', 'Comment 02', ...(2) ] to deeply equal [ ... ]
+   "Completed task row"
```

```
+   "Comment 01"  "Comment 02"  "Comment 03"  "Comment 04"  "Comment 05"
    "Comment 06"  ...
```

i.e. exactly the divergence the card measured: the completed activity back on
screen, and the page window gone. The **fourth case passed** — and it is the
NEUTRAL FIXTURE, which is the predicted arm, not a miss: on a feed with nothing
to filter and nothing to page, binding the pipeline changes nothing, so that leg
must stay green under the mutation or it was never a control.

**RESTORE arm** — `git checkout HEAD -- packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`,
verified by `git diff HEAD` being empty and the blob hash back to `f4fb0b7`
(not by the restore command's exit code, and not by the trap having fired).
Re-run: 4 of 4 pass.

Reasoned unaffected: both `RecordChatterPanel` and `RecordChatterRenderer` are re-exported from the SAME already-eagerly-imported `@object-ui/plugin-detail` barrel, so no module enters or leaves the closure |

All heavy runs went through the container's shared verify lock; the wall-clock
figures in those logs are shared-box readings, so only the verdicts are quoted.

Both doc gates first returned **exit 2 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (packages
unbuilt), which is not a pass; the scoped build each names was run and they were
re-run to the exit codes above.

## Assumptions from the dispatch, checked

- "`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:880-883` emits `record:discussion` on every
  synthesized default page" — **holds, and the anchors happen to be exact at
  this base.** Re-derived by symbol: `buildDefaultDiscussion` is defined at
  `:882` and called at `:1031`, guarded only by an authored `slots.discussion`
  override or the explicit `hideDiscussion` option. Same for the triage's
  `RecordDetailView` anchors (`:2182`, `:2549`, `:1551`) — all three landed on
  the named construct.
- "the feed pipeline is reachable without a new package dependency" — **holds**;
  measurement above. Not a manual-floor item.
- "there are exactly TWO chatter surfaces" — **holds.** A repo-wide sweep for
  `RecordChatterPanel` mount sites outside tests finds exactly two, plus the
  component's own definition. `record:activity` is a different block, and the
  designer palette entry in `metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts` is a
  catalogue row, not a mount.
- Serial adjacency re-derived against currently-open PRs rather than cited from
  the dispatch — see the report; no overlap with the four PRs named there.

## Not in scope

objectui#8934's own ruling is untouched; this is its residue. objectui#8968
(`filterMode` / `enableMentions` still unread on the chatter path) is unaffected
either way — it is a gap in the shared pipeline, so binding the fallback to that
pipeline neither widens nor narrows it.

## Acceptance notes

Seen while working here, deliberately NOT filed and NOT fixed in this PR — none
is a reproducible defect, a broken declared contract, or a trap that makes an
author write metadata the runtime drops:

- `RecordChatterPanel` now has no mount site anywhere in this repository outside
  `RecordChatterRenderer` and this PR's own pre-fix control. It remains a
  published export of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and consumers mount it, so this
  is not dead code — recorded only so the single remaining internal mount does
  not read as an accident to the next person here.
- `AGENTS.md`'s testing section quotes `app-shell` as having "281" test files
  while illustrating a historical trap. Measured today: 676. Nothing reads that
  number mechanically, it sits inside an anecdote rather than a judged
  population, and `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface where a drive-by edit costs
  a human merge. No taker identified; noted rather than filed for that reason.
- The dispatch's serial-adjacency snapshot named four open PRs (`objectui#8920`,
  `#8996`, `#8998`, `#8999`). Re-derived live: eight PRs are open and none of
  them is any of those four. Adjacency was therefore re-derived rather than
  cited, and no open PR touches either file this PR edits.
